auditScope: testimonial and faq CPT ACF fields

classificationDefinitions.preserve_exact_live: The current ACF value corresponds to rendered production copy or behavior. Do not change it.
classificationDefinitions.preserve_exact_live_but_frontend_uses_na: The ACF question equals the visible production question, but the FAQ query renders native title rather than this ACF field.
classificationDefinitions.preserve_exact_shared_copy_but_frontend_: The ACF answer exactly corresponds to current shared-page frontend copy, but the /faqs query renders native content rather than this ACF field.
classificationDefinitions.preserve_unbound: The current value is not consumed by the relevant renderer. Keep it; production does not justify a replacement.
classificationDefinitions.uncertain_inactive_fallback_only: The value has exact correspondence only to an inactive hardcoded fallback. It is not established as visible production copy, so no native-content update is proposed.

testimonials.behavior: testimonialFields.reviewerName, quote, and platform are queried and rendered. rating is queried but discarded by the mapper; the shared section displays hardcoded five-star/5.0 UI.
sharedUnmodeledCopy: Rated 5 out of 5 stars based on verified client feedback.

faqs.behavior: The FAQ query requests native title and content only. It does not request faqFields.question or faqFields.answer. Every FAQ native content value is empty in the backup, so /faqs renders 29 questions with empty answers and emits empty acceptedAnswer text.
faqs.productionEvidence: audit-evidence/live-faqs.html contains all 29 native titles and answer:"" in the page payload; its FAQPage JSON-LD also has text:"" for every accepted answer.
faqs.inactiveFallback: components/pages/FaqsPage.tsx:18-85 contains 15 hardcoded category answers, but line 95 makes any nonempty WordPress FAQ list take precedence. Production supplies 29 FAQ records, so that fallback is inactive.
faqs.sharedUnmodeledCopy: Shared FAQ questions/answers are hardcoded page-specific arrays; shared heading is hardcoded in components/site/FaqsSection.tsx:70 and shared intro comes from page-level ACF or a component default, not FAQ CPT ACF.

rendererFindings.scriptPayloadCaution: Next.js script payloads are transport data, not independently visible content. They are used only to corroborate component inputs and are not labeled as visible evidence.
